messages:
Anna (CS): Ok team — final smoke for Coastline tomorrow morning. Quota request is 1.2M tokens/day with burst up to 2.5M for promotional traffic. We need autoscale policy, load script owner, and a quick fallback plan. Who can take the load test?
Jordan (SE): I can own the load script. Can you share a traffic profile? also need the model variants you want us to test against.
Anna (CS): Traffic mix: 70% short queries (<=60 tokens), 25% medium (200-400 tokens), 5% long (800-1200). Primary model: rwd-llama-13b-quant. Fallbacks: rwd-llama-7b-8bit then hosted rwd-chat-small.
Sam (Oncall): For autoscale, recommend: scale-up when queue_length > 40 OR p95 latency > 180ms for 30s. scale-down after 3m stable. Also set a hard cap at pool size 40 to avoid runaway cost.
Ravi (Ops Lead): noted. I'll wire the autoscale policy into the dedicated pool and pre-warm KV cache. Also want a dry-run alert channel and a runbook link.
Kelly (PM): Customer flagged latency sensitivity — they want p95 < 200ms. Renewal in ~6 weeks, so this go-live affects renewal risk. Please capture cost delta (expected tokens/day * unit cost) and perf delta vs fallback.
Jordan (SE): Working draft of the load command (quick smoke):
```bash
# k6-like synthetic via loader framework
loader run 
  --target https://redwood-dedicated.coastline/api/v1/generate 
  --concurrency 150 
  --ramp 5m --duration 20m 
  --profile mix:short=70,med=25,long=5 
  --model rwd-llama-13b-quant 
  --headers 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Jordan (SE): I'll check-in with Sam before running the full 20m blast. Starting with a 5m smoke at 05:00 UTC for canary.
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved at 05:00 UTC in eu-west-1; capacity request queued (pool: coast-001).
Sam (Oncall): During smoke we'll watch these dashboards: p50/p95/p99 latency, queue_length, GPU_util per node, and error_rate. Slack alert if error_rate > 0.5% for 2 minutes.
Ravi (Ops Lead): Runbook steps (short): 1) deploy config, 2) pre-warm caches (2000 requests small), 3) start 5m smoke (concurrency 50), 4) if stable -> 20m blast, 5) validate SLOs & cost report, 6) approve go-live. I'll post the full runbook link in a sec.
Anna (CS): Please add a quick metric we can share with customer: expected cost bump (daily) and expected p95. Kelly needs that for renewal deck.
Jordan (SE): Will produce a CSV with per-profile token counts + estimated cost using current unit rates.
Kelly (PM): Add a short customer-facing note: what fallbacks are enabled and what latency/cost tradeoffs look like. We want to be transparent pre-cutover.
Sam (Oncall): Also adding automatic fallback rules: if overall capacity saturated (queue > 100 for 1m) then route 30% of traffic to hosted fallback region and 20% to smaller model; remaining requests get degraded responses with short summary and link to retry.
Anna (CS): Great. Last ask — capture any observed regressions in quality for the smaller model during the test. Jordan, please include 50 sample pairs (orig vs fallback) in the post-run report.
Ravi (Ops Lead): I'm on standby for the 05:00 window. If anything looks off we have immediate rollback to the previous slot.
Anna (CS): Thanks all — Ping me here once the 5m smoke completes. :thumbsup:
